description: This file defines the 'Language' class and related structures in the tinygettext namespace, providing functionality for language code handling, comparison, and creation from various string formats.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: A lightweight wrapper around LanguageSpec for handling language codes, names, and comparisons.

methods.name: from_spec
methods.description: Creates a Language object from language, country, and modifier codes.

methods.name: from_name
methods.description: Creates a Language object from a language name or code string.

methods.name: from_env
methods.description: Creates a Language object from an environment variable style string.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Compares two Language objects, returning a match score between 1 and 9 or 0 for mismatch.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two Language objects.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two Language objects.
